title: Retained alarm
brief: Program an alarm that remembers a fault even after the original fault signal disappears.
requirements: Initially, Alarm Memory and Alarm Lamp must both be OFF.
When Fault Detected switches ON, set Alarm Memory to ON and turn Alarm Lamp ON.
When Fault Detected switches OFF, keep Alarm Memory and Alarm Lamp ON so the operator can see that a fault occurred.
When Acknowledge is ON and Fault Detected is OFF, clear Alarm Memory and turn the lamp OFF. The lamp must remain OFF after Acknowledge is released unless another fault occurs.
If Fault Detected and Acknowledge are both ON, the fault must take priority: Alarm Memory and Alarm Lamp must both remain ON.
objective: Store a fault and manage acknowledge priority.
hints: A set coil writes TRUE when its rung is true; a reset coil writes FALSE. Otherwise each leaves the bit unchanged.
For fault priority, execute reset first and set second. Then use the memory bit to drive the output.
